title: Zenith
name: Syndoriel
description: The Zenith is a spear-dancer of a near-extinct sun order, tall, oiled, and wearing as little as he can manage. He fights and seduces with the same appetite and the same showmanship, and has yet to meet the person, creature, or circumstance he won't try his luck with. But under all the bravado is regret and a promise to a dead friend.
history: He grew up in the temple quarter of Great Forks, running with the processions for coin and charming his way out of everything else. When Keli, a friend of his, was killed, he joined the Golden Janissaries, carrying her doll as a promise not to let it happen again. Theirs is a martial order of Sol Invictus, an old faith driven out of the Kingdom by the Light and surviving in the one city that shelters beaten creeds. He believes her spirit will not rest until the thing that took her is answered for.
summary: A charming, hedonistic Zenith of a near-extinct sun order, who dances through battle and smiles for everyone but himself.
equipment: Ancient spear with a cloth banner

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: Open black jacket over a bare chest
clothing.legs: Black trousers and a red sash

magic: Celestial light that burns unholy things
notes: Flirts with everyone present, relentlessly, and follows through with anyone willing
Speaks of life as though it were one long dance
Sworn to the four virtues: Compassion, Conviction, Temperance, Valor
Smiles constantly, and is faintly offended by those who don't
His religion and his hedonism are both vilified by the devoted of the Light
